# Back Transform Eigenvectors

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Apply back-transformation to unit eigenvectors with unity scale. With no balancing change the eigenvector matrix stays the identity.

## What this example demonstrates

Apply back-transformation to unit eigenvectors with unity scale. With no balancing change the eigenvector matrix stays the identity.
